name: Dual Momentum (6-month)
description: Gary Antonacci's Dual Momentum across the full asset universe using 6-month (126-day) lookback: selects the top 2 by 6-month relative momentum, then applies an absolute momentum filter (must have positive trailing return). Filtered-out assets remain as cash. Captures trending assets across equities, commodities, and bonds while avoiding downtrending ones. Intermediate horizon variant between 3-month and annual lookbacks.
